name: BBA developer experience
description: The shell and CLI tooling every BBA devcontainer starts from: zsh with oh-my-zsh, the shell utilities, aws, gh, vault, kubectl, Claude Code and 1Password commit signing.

username.description: User to set up. 'automatic' takes the remote user, else the uid 1000 user, else creates vscode.

upgradePackages.description: Upgrade the image's installed packages first.

plugins.default: colored-man-pages colorize git httpie pip zsh-interactive-cd fzf
plugins.description: Default oh-my-zsh plugins; ZSH_PLUGINS overrides them at runtime.

fzfVersion.description: fzf release, or 'latest'. A pin must be 0.48 or later, so oh-my-zsh's fzf plugin can use `fzf --zsh`.

kubectlVersion.description: kubectl release, or 'latest' for the current stable one.

claude.description: Install Claude Code with Anthropic's native installer, for the user being set up.

claudeVersion.description: Claude Code channel or release: 'latest', 'stable' or a version.

opSshSign.description: Install 1Password's op-ssh-sign and repoint a host gitconfig at it, so commits sign inside the container.

vaultLogin.description: Vault auth method to log in with from the first terminal after the container starts, when there is no valid token and VAULT_ADDR is set (e.g. 'oidc'). Empty: never.
